# wh (who/what/where/when)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:typeWh`](gmeow-typeWh.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/typeWh>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A who/what/where/when question — its answerhood condition is an open set of instantiations of a variable (the individual filling the wh-slot). The constituent-question kind, distinct from the closed alternative set.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:typeWh`](gmeow-typeWh.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md).
